body:
Calibrations for `skills/3-weekly/radar/SKILL.md` from the Oct 14th run on BinoidCBD/LTVera-Pandas (https://github.com/BinoidCBD/LTVera-Pandas/issues/775, "Radar SDLC & Strategic Audit (2026-10-14)"). That report's counts were right and 20 of its claims about code and tracker state were wrong (verification comment on the issue, Oct 15th, 11:45 am PT). None of the 20 had a skill instruction requiring a check that would have caught it. Two reruns of the unmodified skill on the same commit reproduced the counts, did not reproduce 7 of the 10 code and tracker errors, reproduced the unread changes-requested review in both, each made 4 new errors of the same classes, minted 16 distinct target IDs for 8 clusters, and would each have created a duplicate of the closed radar board.

The calibration PR (linked below once opened) makes these changes, body only, frontmatter untouched, no new tests (GH-831):

1. Verify before naming a fix: open the named code at the trunk SHA, quote the lines showing the mechanism is absent, search the log after the window end, check whether the shape already exists; otherwise print `hypothesis, not checked against code`.
2. Explicit midnight window bounds with a time zone, and the trunk SHA recorded in the header.
3. Issue reads carry `state`; closed issues are history of a class, not live members; `--limit` on every `gh issue list`.
4. Reopens count only after 24 hours.
5. PR reads carry `reviewDecision` and `latestReviews`; changes requested is classified as blocked.
6. Cancelled CI runs are neither red nor green; fail-closed-by-design workflows are an operator decision; E1's qualifying lane defined.
7. Missing trigger inputs are `unavailable`, never a proxy; the pause wording names what fired.
8. Reconciler and version-record commits join the Harness families.
9. The ledger is joined to GitHub before any row is counted; vendored `.xyz/` paths; placeholder `milestoneRef` treated as no join.
10. Narrative numbers come from a lens table or are labelled an estimate; "done" needs the repo's state word and evidence.
11. "Regressed After Declared Fixed" cells name issues, never PRs; the guard cell never recommends adding a guard.
12. New target IDs are matched to recorded ones by member overlap before a new slug is minted.
13. Sink A is committed on confirmation or marked local.
14. Sink B searches closed issues, stops on a closed board, uses `--body-file`; an open `radar`-labelled issue without a target heading is not the board.
15. Precedence guardrail: documents and the ledger never supply state.
16. The no-new-tests citation names XYZ-forge's AGENTS.md.

Acceptance evidence: the edited skill run on LTVera-Pandas at 8eccd521 (Claude Opus, read-only) produced the targeted behaviours; details in the PR body. Not exercised: the `hypothesis, not checked against code` branch, and the operator's model (Gemini 4 Argon).

Related, outside this skill (to be filed separately): the relay reviewer prompt bars the checks a report needs and still allows Approved; LTVera-Pandas instruction files name two sources of truth for work state; LTVera ledger reconcile gaps (BinoidCBD/LTVera-Pandas#511).

Review by Claude Code, Oct 15th; the full review and the run outputs are in the LTVera-Pandas workspace and available on request.
title: radar: calibrations from the LTVera-Pandas 2026-10-14 run (BinoidCBD/LTVera-Pandas#775)
